newsitem.title: FINLAND: Raisio says to raise pasta production.
newsitem.headline: Raisio says to raise pasta production.

text.p: Finnish food, feed and chemicals group Raision Tehtaat Oy Ab said on Thursday it would invest 33 million markka to expand pasta production at its Melia unit.
"Melia, a grain processing company in the Raisio group, is installing a new macaroni production line in Raisio, scheduled for opening at the beginning of December," Raisio said in a statement.
"The investments will more than double the factory's macaroni output capacity," Raisio said. @
Melia exported more than 130 million markka worth of pasta, flakes and other grain products last year, mainly to Russia and the Baltic region, it said.
"Demand has thus exceeded production capacity," it said.
